description:
FOUND s499a (Opus, 2026-09-27, measurement only), ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s499/s499a/REPORT.md.

PROFILE (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s499/s499a/profiles/0846-Mian-Chowla-sequence.txt, Rosetta, sb-sprof :cpu, 6456 samples): pcl:p-hash-fill 97.4 % inclusive; puthash/equal 52 %, %make-p-box + make-p-box 12-17 %, grow-hash-table 16.9 % + rehash 3.2 %, sxhash-string 4.5 %.  The program copies a hash every iteration (`my %these = %sums; ... %sums = %these;`).
MECHANISM (read, p-hash-fill): a hash-table source is first flattened into an adjustable vector with `(make-p-box k)` per key, then the target is cleared and filled pair by pair -- the target never gets a :size, so it regrows from empty on every copy.
WHO PAYS: one Rosetta program measured (pcl 6.24 s vs perl 4.38 s warm); the idiom (`my %copy = %h`, `%h = (%h, k => v)`) is ordinary Perl, so the cost is wider than one program, but only this one was measured.
CANDIDATE SHAPE (not designed): a hash-to-hash arm that copies keys raw and values by the element rule, with the target presized to the source's count.
=== DONE (s499f) ===
SHIPPED as commit "s499f M1 (#2424)" (runtime-only, no emission change).  p-hash-fill with a TABLE source and a distinct table target copies key by key (%p-hash-fill-from-hash: keys raw, values by %p-make-hash-entry, the construction arm of the write rule); `%h = %h' keeps the snapshot path.  `my %h = %src' binds a table PRESIZED to the source's count (%p-let-presize at p-let expansion -> %p-make-hash-like, sources > 16 keys).
SIZED (runtime A/B, patched core, warm, best-of-5): hcopy micro 0.503 -> 0.258 s (-48.8 %); Mian-Chowla 5.360 -> 3.037 s (-43.3 %), presize a further -24 %.
WHOLE TREE vs e51abda1: Mian-Chowla 5.424 -> 2.487 s (-54.2 %; perl 3.986 s -- PCL now faster than perl); bench hashcopy 0.481 -> 0.188 s (-60.9 %).
Guard Pl/t/perf-levers-06.t (mechanism rows 1,2,4,7 FAIL on the base; answer rows: the self-copy %s = %s, number/undef/empty/utf8 keys, %$ref = %$other, a big source through a ref, a blessed source, raw-ness of copied values, no aliasing of \$copy{k}; a tied source was probed (base-identical) but has no row).  Gate 270/9159 PASS, sweep 18714 (+0), everyday 102 of 122 unchanged.  Record: faster-codegen §0.2s, DECIDED ## s499f.
subject: PERF: `%a = %b` (a whole-hash copy) goes through p-hash-fill's flatten path -- every key BOXED into a temporary vector, then re-inserted into a table that is never presized; Mian-Chowla spends 97 % of 6.2 s there (perl 4.4 s)
